import json,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'nuvem')
from benchmark import solver_bridge as b
from benchmark.extract.from_solver import project_from_solver
from benchmark.runner import evaluate_project
data=json.loads(Path('docs/checkpoints/evidence/main-safe-engineering-input.json').read_text());m=b.engine();nodes,walls,ends,openings=b.plan_from_input(data);base=b._ft(612)
raised=[]
for line,t,locks in walls:
 a,c=line.GetEndPoint(0),line.GetEndPoint(1);raised.append((m.Line.CreateBound(m.XYZ(a.X,a.Y,base),m.XYZ(c.X,c.Y,base)),t,locks))
walls,junctions=m.extend_wall_ends_to_junctions(raised,m.JUNCTION_FACE_SEARCH_FT);nodes,ends=m.build_wall_graph(walls,junctions);cat,cells,dropped=b.catalog_from_input(data)
h=m._PostCreationEventHandler();h.controlled_beta=True;h.walls_to_create=walls;h.wall_graph_nodes=nodes;h.wall_end_to_node=ends;h.openings_per_wall=openings;h.catalog=cat;h.base_z_abs=base;h.wall_height_ft=b._ft(340);h.selected_level=object();h._execute_solve();h._require_current_beta_solve();r=h.solve_result
project=project_from_solver('native_z_bench',r,walls,nodes,openings,cat,base,r['num_courses'],metadata={});ref=json.loads(Path('nuvem/benchmark/projects/torre_easy_lo_r00_tp1/reference.json').read_text());f,s,c=evaluate_project(project,ref)
expected=json.loads(Path('docs/checkpoints/evidence/main-safe-handler-bench.json').read_text())['result_project'];assert project['walls']==expected['walls'];assert not f and not s['validator_errors'];assert r['beta_preflight']['ok']
out={'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'scope':'Existing-wall axes at actual base Z612cm, default extension and real handler solve; Revit geometry stubs only.','same_physical_walls_as_zero_z_axes':True,'preflight':r['beta_preflight'],'score':s,'wall_endpoints_z_cm':[[m._ft_to_cm(l.GetEndPoint(i).Z) for i in (0,1)] for l,t,k in walls]}
with Path('docs/checkpoints/evidence/main-safe-native-z.json').open('x') as p:json.dump(out,p,indent=2)
print(json.dumps({k:out[k] for k in ('same_physical_walls_as_zero_z_axes','preflight','wall_endpoints_z_cm')}))
